{
  "headings": [
    {"source": "S0287", "text": "Opening of Technical Proposals", "headingDecision": "TRUE_HEADING", "role": "SECTION"},
    {"source": "S0288", "text": "The Procuring Agency’s evaluation committee shall conduct the opening of the Technical Proposals in the presence of the shortlisted Consultants’ authorized representatives who choose to attend (in person, or online if this option is offered in the Data Sheet). The opening date, time and the address are stated in the Data Sheet.", "headingDecision": "NOT_TRUE_HEADING", "role": "BODY_FRAGMENT"},
    {"source": "S0289", "text": "At the opening of the Technical Proposals the following shall be read out: (i) the name and the country of the Consultant or, in case of a Joint Venture, the name of the Joint Venture, the name of the lead member and the names and the countries of all members; (ii) any modifications to the Proposal submitted prior to proposal submission deadline; and (iv) any other information deemed appropriate or as indicated in the Data Sheet.", "headingDecision": "NOT_TRUE_HEADING", "role": "BODY_FRAGMENT"},
    {"source": "S0290", "text": "Proposals Evaluation", "headingDecision": "TRUE_HEADING", "role": "SECTION"},
    {"source": "S0291", "text": "The Consultant is not permitted to alter or modify its Proposal in any way after the proposal submission deadline except as permitted under ITC 12.7. While evaluating the Proposals, the Procuring Agency will conduct the evaluation solely on the basis of the submitted Technical Proposals.", "headingDecision": "NOT_TRUE_HEADING", "role": "BODY_FRAGMENT"},
    {"source": "S0292", "text": "Evaluation of Technical Proposals", "headingDecision": "TRUE_HEADING", "role": "SECTION"},
    {"source": "S0293", "text": "The Procuring Agency’s evaluation committee shall evaluate the Technical Proposals on the basis of their responsiveness to the Terms of Reference and the RFP, applying the evaluation criteria, sub-criteria, and point system specified in the Data Sheet. Each responsive Proposal will be given a technical score. A Proposal shall be rejected at this stage if it does not respond to important aspects of the RFP or if it fails to achieve the minimum technical score indicated in the Data Sheet.", "headingDecision": "NOT_TRUE_HEADING", "role": "BODY_FRAGMENT"},
    {"source": "S0294", "text": "D. Negotiations and conclusion of a Framework Agreement", "headingDecision": "TRUE_HEADING", "role": "CHAPTER"},
    {"source": "S0295", "text": "Negotiations", "headingDecision": "TRUE_HEADING", "role": "SECTION"},
    {"source": "S0296", "text": "The negotiations will be held individually with the top-ranked Consultant(s), within the range specified in the Data Sheet), evaluated in accordance with ITC 21 at the date and address indicated in the Data Sheet. The Consultant’s representative(s) participating in the negotiations must have written power of attorney to negotiate and sign Framework Agreement/s on behalf of the Consultant/s.", "headingDecision": "NOT_TRUE_HEADING", "role": "BODY_FRAGMENT"},
    {"source": "S0297", "text": "The Procuring Agency shall prepare minutes of negotiations that are signed by the Procuring Agency and the respective Consultant’s authorized representative.", "headingDecision": "NOT_TRUE_HEADING", "role": "BODY_FRAGMENT"},
    {"source": "S0298", "text": "a. Availability of Key Experts", "headingDecision": "TRUE_HEADING", "role": "SUBSECTION"},
    {"source": "S0299", "text": "The invited Consultant(s) shall confirm the availability of all Key Experts included in the Proposal(s) as a pre-requisite to the negotiations, or, if applicable, a replacement in accordance with ITC 12. Failure to confirm the Key Experts’ availability may result in the rejection of the Consultant’s Proposal and the Procuring Agency proceeding to negotiate the Framework Agreement with the next-ranked Consultant.", "headingDecision": "NOT_TRUE_HEADING", "role": "BODY_FRAGMENT"},
    {"source": "S0300", "text": "Notwithstanding the above, the substitution of Key Experts at the negotiations may be considered if due solely to circumstances outside the reasonable control of and not foreseeable by the Consultant, including but not limited to death or medical incapacity. In such case, the Consultant shall offer substitute Key Expert/s within the period of time specified in the letter of invitation to negotiate the Framework Agreement, who shall have equivalent or better qualifications and experience than the original candidate/s.", "headingDecision": "NOT_TRUE_HEADING", "role": "BODY_FRAGMENT"},
    {"source": "S0301", "text": "b. Technical Negotiations", "headingDecision": "TRUE_HEADING", "role": "SUBSECTION"},
    {"source": "S0302", "text": "The negotiations include discussions of the Terms of Reference (TORs), the proposed approach and methodology, the proposed Key Experts, the Framework Agreement provisions, and finalizing the TOR to be included in the Framework Agreement. These discussions shall not substantially alter the original scope of services under the TOR or the terms of the Framework Agreement", "headingDecision": "NOT_TRUE_HEADING", "role": "BODY_FRAGMENT"},
    {"source": "S0303", "text": "c. Clarification of tax liability", "headingDecision": "TRUE_HEADING", "role": "SUBSECTION"},
    {"source": "S0304", "text": "The negotiations may include the clarification of the Consultant’s/s’ tax liability in the Borrower’s country and how it should be reflected in the Call-off Contract(s).", "headingDecision": "NOT_TRUE_HEADING", "role": "BODY_FRAGMENT"},
    {"source": "S0305", "text": "Conclusion of Negotiations", "headingDecision": "TRUE_HEADING", "role": "SECTION"},
    {"source": "S0306", "text": "The negotiations are concluded with a review of the finalized draft Framework Agreement/s, which then shall be initialed by the Procuring Agency and the Consultant’s/s’ authorized representative/s.", "headingDecision": "NOT_TRUE_HEADING", "role": "BODY_FRAGMENT"},
    {"source": "S0307", "text": "If the negotiations with a Consultant fail, the Procuring Agency shall inform the Consultant in writing of all pending issues and disagreements and provide a final opportunity to the Consultant to respond. If disagreement persists, the Procuring Agency shall terminate the negotiations informing the Consultant of the reasons for doing so. The Procuring Agency will continue negotiations with the remaining top-ranked Consultant(s), and shall not reopen the earlier terminated negotiations.", "headingDecision": "NOT_TRUE_HEADING", "role": "BODY_FRAGMENT"},
    {"source": "S0308", "text": "Standstill Period", "headingDecision": "TRUE_HEADING", "role": "SECTION"},
    {"source": "S0309", "text": "The Framework Agreement(s) shall not be concluded earlier than the expiry of the Standstill Period. The Standstill Period shall be ten (10) Business Days unless extended in accordance with ITC 29. The Standstill Period commences the day after the date the Procuring Agency has transmitted to each Consultant (that has not already been notified that it has been unsuccessful) the Notification of Intention to conclude a Framework Agreement. Where only one Proposal is submitted, or if this Primary Procurement is in response to an emergency situation recognized by the Bank, the Standstill Period shall not apply.", "headingDecision": "NOT_TRUE_HEADING", "role": "BODY_FRAGMENT"},
    {"source": "S0310", "text": "Notification of Intention to Conclude a Framework Agreement", "headingDecision": "TRUE_HEADING", "role": "SECTION"},
    {"source": "S0311", "text": "The Procuring Agency shall send to each consultant that submitted a proposal, the Notification of Intention to Conclude a Framework Agreement(s) with the successful Consultant(s). The Notification of Intention to Conclude shall contain, at a minimum, the following information:", "headingDecision": "NOT_TRUE_HEADING", "role": "BODY_FRAGMENT"},
    {"source": "S0312", "text": "the name and address of the Consultant(s) with whom the Procuring Agency successfully negotiated a Framework Agreement/s;", "headingDecision": "NOT_TRUE_HEADING", "role": "LIST_ITEM"},
    {"source": "S0313", "text": "the names of all Consultants included in the short list, indicating those that submitted Proposals;", "headingDecision": "NOT_TRUE_HEADING", "role": "LIST_ITEM"},
    {"source": "S0314", "text": "the overall technical scores and scores assigned for each criterion and sub-criterion to each Consultant;", "headingDecision": "NOT_TRUE_HEADING", "role": "LIST_ITEM"},
    {"source": "S0315", "text": "the technical ranking of the Consultants;", "headingDecision": "NOT_TRUE_HEADING", "role": "LIST_ITEM"},
    {"source": "S0316", "text": "a statement of the reason(s) why the recipient’s Proposal was unsuccessful;", "headingDecision": "NOT_TRUE_HEADING", "role": "LIST_ITEM"},
    {"source": "S0317", "text": "the expiry date of the Standstill Period; and", "headingDecision": "NOT_TRUE_HEADING", "role": "LIST_ITEM"},
    {"source": "S0318", "text": "instructions on how to request a debriefing and/or submit a complaint during the Standstill Period.", "headingDecision": "NOT_TRUE_HEADING", "role": "LIST_ITEM"},
    {"source": "S0319", "text": "Framework Agreement Criteria", "headingDecision": "TRUE_HEADING", "role": "SECTION"},
    {"source": "S0320", "text": "This is a Closed Framework Agreement. The criteria that applies in the selection of Consultant(s), with whom a Framework Agreement(s) may be concluded is specified in the Data Sheet.", "headingDecision": "NOT_TRUE_HEADING", "role": "BODY_FRAGMENT"},
    {"source": "S0321", "text": "No Obligation to Procure", "headingDecision": "TRUE_HEADING", "role": "SECTION"},
    {"source": "S0322", "text": "The conclusion of a Framework Agreement shall not impose any obligation on the Procuring Agency and/or Client(s) to procure any Services under the Framework Agreement.", "headingDecision": "NOT_TRUE_HEADING", "role": "BODY_FRAGMENT"},
    {"source": "S0323", "text": "Non-exclusivity", "headingDecision": "TRUE_HEADING", "role": "SECTION"},
    {"source": "S0324", "text": "This Primary Procurement is non-exclusive, and the Procuring Agency reserves the right to procure the consulting services from other consultants who are not in the Framework Agreement.", "headingDecision": "NOT_TRUE_HEADING", "role": "BODY_FRAGMENT"},
    {"source": "S0325", "text": "Notification to conclude a Framework Agreement", "headingDecision": "TRUE_HEADING", "role": "SECTION"},
    {"source": "S0326", "text": "Prior to the date of expiry of the proposal validity and upon expiry of the Standstill Period, specified in ITC 24.1 or any extension thereof, and upon satisfactorily addressing any complaint that has been submitted within the Standstill Period, the Procuring Agency shall transmit to the successful Consultant(s) a Notification to Conclude a Framework Agreement, attaching the Framework Agreement for signature by the Consultant (s), and a request to submit the completed Beneficial Ownership Disclosure Form within eight (8) Business Days of receiving the request.", "headingDecision": "NOT_TRUE_HEADING", "role": "BODY_FRAGMENT"},
    {"source": "S0327", "text": "Debriefing by the Procuring Agency", "headingDecision": "TRUE_HEADING", "role": "SECTION"},
    {"source": "S0328", "text": "On receipt of the Procuring Agency’s Notification of Intention to Conclude a Framework Agreement(s), referred to in ITC 25.1, an unsuccessful Consultant has three (3) Business Days to make a written request to the Procuring Agency for a debriefing. The Procuring Agency shall provide a debriefing to all unsuccessful Consultants whose request is received within this deadline.", "headingDecision": "NOT_TRUE_HEADING", "role": "BODY_FRAGMENT"},
    {"source": "S0329", "text": "Where a request for debriefing is received within the deadline, the Procuring Agency shall provide a debriefing within five (5) Business Days, unless the Procuring Agency decides, for justifiable reasons, to provide the debriefing outside this timeframe. In that case, the standstill period shall automatically be extended until five (5) Business Days after such debriefing is provided. If more than one debriefing is so delayed, the standstill period shall not end earlier than five (5) Business Days after the last debriefing takes place. The Procuring Agency shall promptly inform, by the quickest means available, all Consultants of the extended standstill period.", "headingDecision": "NOT_TRUE_HEADING", "role": "BODY_FRAGMENT"},
    {"source": "S0330", "text": "Where a request for debriefing is received by the Procuring Agency later than the three (3)-Business Day deadline, the Procuring Agency should provide the debriefing as soon as practicable, and normally no later than fifteen (15) Business Days from the date of publication of the Conclusion of Framework Agreement Notice. Requests for debriefing received outside the three (3)-day deadline shall not lead to extension of the standstill period.", "headingDecision": "NOT_TRUE_HEADING", "role": "BODY_FRAGMENT"},
    {"source": "S0331", "text": "Debriefings of unsuccessful Consultants may be done in writing or verbally. The Consultants shall bear their own costs of attending such a debriefing meeting.", "headingDecision": "NOT_TRUE_HEADING", "role": "BODY_FRAGMENT"},
    {"source": "S0332", "text": "Signing the Framework Agreement", "headingDecision": "TRUE_HEADING", "role": "SECTION"},
    {"source": "S0333", "text": "The Consultant shall sign, date and return the Framework Agreement within the period specified in the Data Sheet, upon receipt of the same.", "headingDecision": "NOT_TRUE_HEADING", "role": "BODY_FRAGMENT"},
    {"source": "S0334", "text": "In case of Multi-User Framework Agreement, the Procuring Agency shall sign each Framework Agreement on behalf of all participating Clients.", "headingDecision": "NOT_TRUE_HEADING", "role": "BODY_FRAGMENT"},
    {"source": "S0335", "text": "Publication of the Conclusion of Framework Agreement Notice", "headingDecision": "TRUE_HEADING", "role": "SECTION"},
    {"source": "S0336", "text": "Within ten (10) Business Days of transmission to the successful Consultant(s) of the Notification(s) to Conclude a Framework Agreement(s), as per ITC 29.1, the Procuring Agency shall publish the Conclusion of Framework Agreement Notice which shall contain, at a minimum, the following information:", "headingDecision": "NOT_TRUE_HEADING", "role": "BODY_FRAGMENT"},
    {"source": "S0337", "text": "name and address of the Procuring Agency, and if applicable, all participating Clients;", "headingDecision": "NOT_TRUE_HEADING", "role": "LIST_ITEM"},
    {"source": "S0338", "text": "name and reference number of the Framework Agreement being concluded, and the selection method used;", "headingDecision": "NOT_TRUE_HEADING", "role": "LIST_ITEM"},
    {"source": "S0339", "text": "names of all Consultants that submitted proposals, and pricing mechanism, if applicable;", "headingDecision": "NOT_TRUE_HEADING", "role": "LIST_ITEM"},
    {"source": "S0340", "text": "names of all Consultants whose proposals were not accepted, with the reasons therefor; and", "headingDecision": "NOT_TRUE_HEADING", "role": "LIST_ITEM"},
    {"source": "S0341", "text": "the name(s) of the successful Consultant(s), the duration of Framework Agreement(s), and a summary of its scope; and", "headingDecision": "NOT_TRUE_HEADING", "role": "LIST_ITEM"},
    {"source": "S0342", "text": "successful Consultant’s (Consultants’) Beneficial Ownership Disclosure Form.", "headingDecision": "NOT_TRUE_HEADING", "role": "LIST_ITEM"},
    {"source": "S0343", "text": "The Conclusion of Framework Agreement Notice shall be published on the Procuring Agency’s website with free access if available, or in at least one newspaper of national circulation in the Procuring Agency’s Country, or in the official gazette.", "headingDecision": "NOT_TRUE_HEADING", "role": "BODY_FRAGMENT"},
    {"source": "S0344", "text": "Procurement Related Complaint", "headingDecision": "TRUE_HEADING", "role": "SECTION"},
    {"source": "S0345", "text": "The procedures for making a Procurement-related Complaint are as specified in the Data Sheet.", "headingDecision": "NOT_TRUE_HEADING", "role": "BODY_FRAGMENT"},
    {"source": "S0346", "text": "Method and criteria for award of Call-off Contract", "headingDecision": "TRUE_HEADING", "role": "SECTION"},
    {"source": "S0347", "text": "The Secondary Procurement method that shall apply in selecting FA Consultant and awarding a Call-off contract is specified in the Framework Agreement (Framework Agreement, Schedule 3, Secondary Procurement). To be entitled to participate in a Secondary Procurement, and awarded a Call-off Contract, FA Consultants must continue to be technically qualified and eligible, as per the criteria stipulated in this RFP. The Client may require, at the Secondary Procurement stage and award of Call-off Contract, evidence of continued technical qualification and eligibility.", "headingDecision": "NOT_TRUE_HEADING", "role": "BODY_FRAGMENT"},
    {"source": "S0348", "text": "Section 2. Instructions to Consultants", "headingDecision": "TRUE_HEADING", "role": "PART"},
    {"source": "S0349", "text": "E. Data Sheet", "headingDecision": "TRUE_HEADING", "role": "CHAPTER"},
    {"source": "S0350", "text": "[“Notes to Procuring Agency” shown in brackets throughout the text are provided for guidance to prepare the Data Sheet; they should be deleted from the final RFP to be sent to the shortlisted Consultants]", "headingDecision": "NOT_TRUE_HEADING", "role": "DECORATIVE_TEXT"},
    {"source": "S0351", "text": "[Where an e-procurement system is used, modify the relevant parts of the Data Sheet to reflect the e-procurement process.]", "headingDecision": "NOT_TRUE_HEADING", "role": "DECORATIVE_TEXT"},

    {"source": "S0367", "text": "[list the parts of process e.g. issuing RFP, submissions of Proposals, opening of Proposals etc. and insert such additional information in this Data Sheet as is required to describe these processes]", "headingDecision": "NOT_TRUE_HEADING", "role": "TABLE_LABEL"},

    {"source": "S0381", "text": "The Procuring Agency intends to conclude a Framework Agreements with a minimum number of Consultants.", "headingDecision": "NOT_TRUE_HEADING", "role": "TABLE_LABEL"},
    {"source": "S0382", "text": "The minimum number (referred to as x) is [insert number in text (insert numerical number).", "headingDecision": "NOT_TRUE_HEADING", "role": "TABLE_LABEL"},
    {"source": "S0383", "text": "Framework Agreement panel – maximum number (y)", "headingDecision": "NOT_TRUE_HEADING", "role": "TABLE_LABEL"},
    {"source": "S0384", "text": "Subject to successful negotiations, the Procuring Agency, will conclude Framework Agreements up to a maximum number of (y) consultants who scored above the minimum technical score (St) required to pass, ranked in terms of their technical scores.", "headingDecision": "NOT_TRUE_HEADING", "role": "TABLE_LABEL"},
    {"source": "S0385", "text": "If the number of successful consultants is less than the minimum (x) , the Procuring Agency may decide to invite new proposals, or alternatively decide to conclude the FA with those consultants.", "headingDecision": "NOT_TRUE_HEADING", "role": "TABLE_LABEL"},

[Note:If applicable, indicate that the initial term may be extended by a maximum of two additional years.]", "headingDecision": "NOT_TRUE_HEADING", "role": "TABLE_LABEL"},

    {"source": "S0393", "text": "OPTION 1: “the agency that will conclude, administer and manage the Framework Agreement, and be the sole Client under the Framework Agreement.”", "headingDecision": "NOT_TRUE_HEADING", "role": "TABLE_LABEL"},
    {"source": "S0394", "text": "OR", "headingDecision": "NOT_TRUE_HEADING", "role": "TABLE_LABEL"},
    {"source": "S0395", "text": "OPTION 2: “the agency acting for, and on behalf of, [select “the Client” or “All participating Clients”] in concluding the Framework Agreement.”", "headingDecision": "NOT_TRUE_HEADING", "role": "TABLE_LABEL"},
    {"source": "S0396", "text": "The reference number of the Request for Proposals (RFP) is: [insert reference number of the Request for Proposals]", "headingDecision": "NOT_TRUE_HEADING", "role": "TABLE_LABEL"},

    {"source": "S0565", "text": "Primary Procurement - Framework Agreement for Consulting Services", "headingDecision": "NOT_TRUE_HEADING", "role": "CAPTION"},
    {"source": "S0566", "text": "Technical Proposal Submission Form", "headingDecision": "NOT_TRUE_HEADING", "role": "CAPTION"},
    {"source": "S0567", "text": "{Location, Date}", "headingDecision": "NOT_TRUE_HEADING", "role": "DECORATIVE_TEXT"},
    {"source": "S0568", "text": "To: [Name and address of Procuring Agency]", "headingDecision": "NOT_TRUE_HEADING", "role": "DECORATIVE_TEXT"},
    {"source": "S0569", "text": "Dear Sirs:", "headingDecision": "NOT_TRUE_HEADING", "role": "DECORATIVE_TEXT"},
    {"source": "S0570", "text": "We, the undersigned, offer to conclude a Framework Agreement for the provision of the consulting services for [Insert title of consulting services] in accordance with your Request for Proposals (RFP) dated [Insert Date] and our Proposal. We are hereby submitting our Proposal, which includes this Technical Proposal in a sealed envelope.", "headingDecision": "NOT_TRUE_HEADING", "role": "BODY_FRAGMENT"},
    {"source": "S0571", "text": "{If the Consultant is a joint venture, insert the following: We are submitting our Proposal a joint venture with: {Insert a list with full name and the legal address of each member, and indicate the lead member}. We have attached a copy {insert: “of our letter of intent to form a joint venture” or, if a JV is already formed, “of the JV agreement”} signed by every participating member, which details the likely legal structure of and the confirmation of joint and severable liability of the members of the said joint venture.", "headingDecision": "NOT_TRUE_HEADING", "role": "BODY_FRAGMENT"},
    {"source": "S0572", "text": "{OR", "headingDecision": "NOT_TRUE_HEADING", "role": "DECORATIVE_TEXT"},
    {"source": "S0573", "text": "If the Consultant’s Proposal includes Sub-consultants, insert the following: We are submitting our Proposal with the following firms as Sub-consultants: {Insert a list with full name and address of each Sub-consultant.}", "headingDecision": "NOT_TRUE_HEADING", "role": "BODY_FRAGMENT"},
    {"source": "S0574", "text": "We hereby declare that:", "headingDecision": "NOT_TRUE_HEADING", "role": "DECORATIVE_TEXT"},
    {"source": "S0575", "text": "All the information and statements made in this Proposal are true and we accept that any misinterpretation or misrepresentation contained in this Proposal may lead to our disqualification by the Procuring Agency and/or may be sanctioned by the Bank.", "headingDecision": "NOT_TRUE_HEADING", "role": "LIST_ITEM"},
    {"source": "S0576", "text": "Our Proposal shall be valid and remain binding upon us until [insert day, month and year in accordance with ITC 12.1].", "headingDecision": "NOT_TRUE_HEADING", "role": "LIST_ITEM"},
    {"source": "S0577", "text": "We have no conflict of interest in accordance with ITC 3.", "headingDecision": "NOT_TRUE_HEADING", "role": "LIST_ITEM"},
    {"source": "S0578", "text": "We meet the eligibility requirements as stated in ITC 6, and we confirm our understanding of our obligation to abide by the Bank’s policy in regard to Fraud and Corruption as per ITC 5.", "headingDecision": "NOT_TRUE_HEADING", "role": "LIST_ITEM"},
    {"source": "S0579", "text": "We, along with any of our sub-consultants, subcontractors, suppliers, or service providers for any part of the contract, are not subject to, and not controlled by any entity or individual that is subject to, a temporary suspension or a debarment imposed by the World Bank Group or a debarment imposed by the World Bank Group in accordance with the Agreement for Mutual Enforcement of Debarment Decisions between the World Bank and other development banks. Further, we are not ineligible under the Borrower’s country laws or official regulations or pursuant to a decision of the United Nations Security Council;", "headingDecision": "NOT_TRUE_HEADING", "role": "LIST_ITEM"},
    {"source": "S0580", "text": "Sexual Exploitation and Abuse (SEA) and/or Sexual Harassment (SH): [select the appropriate option from (i) to (iii) below and delete the others].", "headingDecision": "NOT_TRUE_HEADING", "role": "LIST_ITEM"},
    {"source": "S0581", "text": "We [where JV, insert: “including any of our JV members”], and any of our sub-consultants:", "headingDecision": "NOT_TRUE_HEADING", "role": "DECORATIVE_TEXT"},
    {"source": "S0582", "text": "[have not been subject to disqualification by the Bank for non-compliance with SEA/ SH obligations.]", "headingDecision": "NOT_TRUE_HEADING", "role": "LIST_ITEM"},
    {"source": "S0583", "text": "[are subject to disqualification by the Bank for non-compliance with SEA/ SH obligations.]", "headingDecision": "NOT_TRUE_HEADING", "role": "LIST_ITEM"},
    {"source": "S0584", "text": "[had been subject to disqualification by the Bank for non-compliance with SEA/ SH obligations. An arbitral award on the disqualification case has been made in our favor.]", "headingDecision": "NOT_TRUE_HEADING", "role": "LIST_ITEM"},
    {"source": "S0585", "text": "[Note to Procuring Agency: Only if required in ITC10.2 (Data Sheet 10.2), include the following: In competing for (and, if the award is made to us, in executing) the Contract, we undertake to observe the laws against fraud and corruption, including bribery, in force in the country of the Borrower.]", "headingDecision": "NOT_TRUE_HEADING", "role": "LIST_ITEM"},
    {"source": "S0586", "text": "Except as stated in the Data Sheet, ITC 12.7, we undertake to negotiate the Framework Agreement on the basis of the proposed Key Experts. We accept that the substitution of Key Experts for reasons other than those stated in ITC 12 and ITC 26.4 may lead to the termination of Contract negotiations.", "headingDecision": "NOT_TRUE_HEADING", "role": "LIST_ITEM"},
    {"source": "S0587", "text": "Our Proposal is binding upon us and subject to any modifications resulting from the Contract negotiations.", "headingDecision": "NOT_TRUE_HEADING", "role": "LIST_ITEM"},
    {"source": "S0588", "text": "We understand that the Procuring Agency is not bound to accept any Proposal that the Procuring Agency receives.", "headingDecision": "NOT_TRUE_HEADING", "role": "BODY_FRAGMENT"},
    {"source": "S0589", "text": "We remain,", "headingDecision": "NOT_TRUE_HEADING", "role": "DECORATIVE_TEXT"},
    {"source": "S0590", "text": "Yours sincerely,", "headingDecision": "NOT_TRUE_HEADING", "role": "DECORATIVE_TEXT"},
    {"source": "S0591", "text": "_________________________________________________________________", "headingDecision": "NOT_TRUE_HEADING", "role": "DECORATIVE_TEXT"},
    {"source": "S0592", "text": "Signature (of Consultant’s authorized representative) {In full and initials}:", "headingDecision": "NOT_TRUE_HEADING", "role": "DECORATIVE_TEXT"},
    {"source": "S0593", "text": "Full name: {insert full name of authorized representative}", "headingDecision": "NOT_TRUE_HEADING", "role": "DECORATIVE_TEXT"},
    {"source": "S0594", "text": "Title: {insert title/position of authorized representative}", "headingDecision": "NOT_TRUE_HEADING", "role": "DECORATIVE_TEXT"},
    {"source": "S0595", "text": "Name of Consultant (company’s name or JV’s name):", "headingDecision": "NOT_TRUE_HEADING", "role": "DECORATIVE_TEXT"},
    {"source": "S0596", "text": "Capacity: {insert the person’s capacity to sign for the Consultant}", "headingDecision": "NOT_TRUE_HEADING", "role": "DECORATIVE_TEXT"},
    {"source": "S0597", "text": "Address: {insert the authorized representative’s address}", "headingDecision": "NOT_TRUE_HEADING", "role": "DECORATIVE_TEXT"},
    {"source": "S0598", "text": "Phone/fax: {insert the authorized representative’s phone and fax number, if applicable}", "headingDecision": "NOT_TRUE_HEADING", "role": "DECORATIVE_TEXT"},
    {"source": "S0599", "text": "Email: {insert the authorized representative’s email address}", "headingDecision": "NOT_TRUE_HEADING", "role": "DECORATIVE_TEXT"},
    {"source": "S0600", "text": "{For a joint venture, either all members shall sign or only the lead member, in which case the power of attorney to sign on behalf of all members shall be attached}", "headingDecision": "NOT_TRUE_HEADING", "role": "DECORATIVE_TEXT"},
    {"source": "S0601", "text": "Form TECH-2", "headingDecision": "NOT_TRUE_HEADING", "role": "CAPTION"},
    {"source": "S0602", "text": "Consultant’s Organization and Experience", "headingDecision": "NOT_TRUE_HEADING", "role": "CAPTION"},
    {"source": "S0603", "text": "Form TECH-2: a brief description of the Consultant’s organization and an outline of the recent experience of the Consultant that is most relevant to the assignment. In the case of a joint venture, information on similar assignments shall be provided for each partner. For each assignment, the outline should indicate the names of the Consultant’s Key Experts and Sub-consultants who participated, the duration of the assignment, the contract amount (total and, if it was done in a form of a joint venture or a sub-consultancy, the amount paid to the Consultant), and the Consultant’s role/involvement.", "headingDecision": "NOT_TRUE_HEADING", "role": "BODY_FRAGMENT"},
    {"source": "S0604", "text": "A - Consultant’s Organization", "headingDecision": "NOT_TRUE_HEADING", "role": "CAPTION"},
    {"source": "S0605", "text": "1. Provide here a brief description of the background and organization of your company, and – in case of a joint venture – of each member for this assignment.", "headingDecision": "NOT_TRUE_HEADING", "role": "BODY_FRAGMENT"},
    {"source": "S0606", "text": "2. Include organizational chart, a list of Board of Directors, and beneficial ownership. The successful Consultant shall also provide additional information on beneficial ownership, using the Beneficial Ownership Disclosure Form.", "headingDecision": "NOT_TRUE_HEADING", "role": "BODY_FRAGMENT"},
    {"source": "S0607", "text": "B - Consultant’s Experience", "headingDecision": "NOT_TRUE_HEADING", "role": "CAPTION"},
    {"source": "S0608", "text": "1. List only previous similar assignments successfully completed in the last [.....] years.", "headingDecision": "NOT_TRUE_HEADING", "role": "BODY_FRAGMENT"},
    {"source": "S0609", "text": "2. List only those assignments for which the Consultant was legally contracted by a client as a company or was one of the joint venture members. Assignments completed by the Consultant’s individual experts working privately or through other consulting firms cannot be claimed as the relevant experience of the Consultant, or that of the Consultant’s partners or sub-consultants, but can be claimed by the Experts themselves in their CVs. The Consultant should be prepared to substantiate the claimed experience by presenting copies of relevant documents and references if so requested by the Procuring Agency.", "headingDecision": "NOT_TRUE_HEADING", "role": "BODY_FRAGMENT"},
